notes: REF-BM-02: metadata route fetches title/description/favicon but never a preview image (no og:image). REF-BM-06: saveBookmark always creates a new item with Date.now() id; no duplicate-url detection or convergence to editing. REF-BM-10: tags are a fixed hardcoded set of 4 toggle chips; no free-text tag entry and no autocomplete, though existing tags are surfaced for selection. REF-BM-12: search covers title/description/tags/domain but only domain (not full url) and there is no separate note field. REF-BM-14: '#tag' is treated as a literal substring, no tag-syntax parsing. REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT/parentheses parsing. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase exact-match handling. REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread/read-later flag or view (only a 'favorite' flag, which is a different concept). REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk actions of any kind. REF-BM-23: a 'Notes' field exists (stored as description) but it is plain text, never rendered as markdown. REF-BM-24/25: no page snapshot, PDF handling, or Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-29: no bundles/saved filters. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import or export. REF-BM-32: Settings nav item is non-functional; sort/view are transient session controls, no persisted display settings (font size, items per page, default sort).
